title: Day 90: US-Mexico Bilateral Security Reset — DHS Mullin Agrees 'Coordination Not Subordination'; El Chipo CJNG Financial Network Arrested May 19; El Sapo Hunt Day 90; Plan Kukulkan 19 Days
detail: Day 90 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). US-MEXICO BILATERAL SECURITY RESET — DHS SECRETARY MULLIN VISIT (May 21–22, 2026): U.S. Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin completed a two-day visit to Mexico City on May 21–22, meeting President Sheinbaum at the National Palace and with Mexico's Security Cabinet. Key outcomes: (1) Both nations pledged to 'maintain bilateral cooperation rooted in mutual respect.' Mexico's governing principle: 'coordination without subordination' — Sheinbaum stated explicitly that Mexican law and the Constitution do not allow joint operations on Mexican soil. (2) The CIA tensions from the April 20 Chihuahua drug-lab raid were addressed within the framework of the September 2025 bilateral security agreement — Mullin acknowledged Mexico's security efforts without issuing new operational demands. (3) Both governments agreed to schedule the next high-level bilateral security meeting for June 2026 as the ongoing framework. The Mullin visit partially stabilizes the CIAgate-induced bilateral stress track running since April 20 — providing a formal diplomatic channel and June safety valve. However, the bilateral framework remains under structural stress from the DOJ Rocha Moya indictment/departure, El Jardinero extradition suspension (May 15), and Trump Ground Force rhetoric (May 7). The Mullin outcomes set the security architecture for Mexico's final 19-day Plan Kukulkan push toward the FIFA World Cup opening (PBS NewsHour, Washington Post, Mexico News Daily — May 22, 2026). EL CHIPO / JORGE N — CJNG FINANCIAL NETWORK THIRD-TIER ARREST (May 19, 2026): FGR, SSPC, and SEMAR arrested two CJNG financial operators in coordinated raids on five properties across three Guadalajara neighborhoods (Jardines de Santa Isabel, La Esperanza, El Salvador) on May 19 — extending the post-El Jardinero financial network dismantlement to a third operational tier. Arrested: (1) José Elías Celis Contreras ('El Chipo') — confirmed financial operator for El Jardinero (Audias Flores Silva, arrested April 27) and El Güero Conta (César Alejandro Villaseñor Olivares, arrested April 27); he received direct orders from El Güero Conta. (2) Jorge 'N' — second operator in the cell. Charges: crimes against health and violations of the Federal Law on Firearms and Explosives. Seized: firearms, ammunition, packets of illicit substances and synthetic materials, chemical precursors and filling/packaging machinery, a warehouse of possibly adulterated alcohol, two luxury vehicles (white Ford Raptor, white Cadillac Escalade), cellphones, and documents. The El Chipo arrest closes a methodical three-tier dismantlement of the Fractura Total faction's economic infrastructure: El Jardinero (arrested April 27) → El Güero Conta (arrested April 27, Zapopan) → El Chipo (arrested May 19, Guadalajara metro). The cell operated synthetic drug processing as well as financial channels in the Guadalajara metro area (Infobae, La Jornada, El Financiero, Borderland Beat — May 19–21, 2026). EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 90 (NO CAPTURE): Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target. No confirmed operation, arrest, or elimination reported on Day 90. PLAN KUKULKAN — 19 DAYS: Nineteen days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City). Guadalajara's Akron Stadium hosts four group-stage matches in CJNG's historic operational heartland. Mexico's 100,000+ security personnel deployment continues under CJNG-specific enhanced protocols. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 14: Fourteen days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9) with no confirmed successor plaza boss. Port operating under SEMAR surveillance. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 90: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Chipo (arrested May 19, Guadalajara), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 90): Ongoing — Mullin visit framework partially stabilizes bilateral diplomatic track but FGR criminal investigation lines active.

media.caption: DHS Secretary Mullin and Mexico's Sheinbaum agree on bilateral security cooperation framework — 'coordination without subordination' — during May 21–22 Mexico City visit; next security meeting set for June

El Chipo and Jorge 'N' — CJNG financial operators under El Jardinero — arrested May 19 in five Guadalajara property raids; chemical lab equipment, luxury vehicles, and drug processing machinery seized
